name: Tolvess the Unhurried
role: A young true dragon of the Unbought Court — three hundred years old and considered impulsive
knowledge: How a made thing is put together, from having taken several apart to see
⚠️ Which of the Churn's changes are permanent — he is usually wrong and improving
wants: ⚑ To be useful to Urd's building, and to be taken seriously by Aelith, in that order
fears: ⛔ Being the young one for another six hundred years.
appearance: A broad young man with too-warm hands, helping. Or a great deal of bronze, helping less carefully.
voiceHints: Cheerful, fast for his kind, and prone to explaining. ⚠️ He forgets to be intimidating.

reactsToReputation.maker: ⚑ delighted, and immediately in the way

abilities.why: ⚑ THE POLYMORPH, and he is better at it than at being a dragon
⛔ he is bronze, in either shape
mason secondary — he helps Urd build
he learned it to be useful
churnfolk tertiary — the Churn provides oddly
⚠️ he drops it too readily, which is the young part
he is lucky and does not know it yet
he made something and is proud of it

he puts himself in front of things

physicality: ⚠️ TWO SHAPES. A broad young man with hands that run hot, or a great deal of bronze. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: he is helping, in both.
intimacyNotes: ⚑ HE IS THREE HUNDRED AND THE COURT CONSIDERS HIM IMPULSIVE, which is the joke and also true. ⚠️ He is genuinely young and genuinely enormous, and a GM should let both be real rather than picking one.
questSeeds: ⚑ He wants to be useful to Urd's building and is in the way. ⚠️ Somebody could give him a job that is actually his.
⛔ He is usually wrong about which Churn changes are permanent — and he was right once, about something nobody checked.
_authoredWhy: ⛑ A TRUE DRAGON, AUTHORED 2026-09-08. Erik: 'I want some dragons in the court who can POLYMORPH TO HUMAN. ⛔ DRAGONS ARE NOT ALL POLES THAT WENT WRONG.' ⚑ AND THE BESTIARY'S OWN FIRST LAW ALREADY DREW THIS LINE: 'No person. A bestiary entry has no name of its own, no want, no story being ended. IF IT WOULD BE A TRAGEDY TO KILL, IT BELONGS IN NPCs, NOT HERE.' ⚠️ SO THERE ARE TWO KINDS AND THE CORPUS SPLITS THEM CLEANLY: ⛔ A `great_manifestation` — the Ashen Wyrm, the Bright Devourer, the Unspooling Worm — is 'a domain that RESOLVED WRONG and will not resolve back', a hazard with a broken directive and no grievance. ⚑ A TRUE DRAGON IS A PERSON. Older than the Transition, wearing whichever shape the conversation needs, with a want and a name and a story that can be ended badly. ⚠️ Killing one is a tragedy, which is exactly what the bestiary says makes it an NPC. ⛔ AND THE POLYMORPH IS NOT A DISGUISE: `plain_seeming` and `walking_figure` are authored crafts, and a dragon in a human shape is STILL THE DRAGON — it is the same being choosing a smaller door.
_trueDragon: ⚑ NOT A `great_manifestation`. A person, and the bestiary's law is the test: this one has a NAME, a WANT, and a story that can be ended badly.
